description: MCP server for Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, VS Code and other MCP-compatible IDEs. Keeps a project's facts (stack, goal, commands) in project.faf, an IANA-registered YAML file (application/vnd.faf+yaml), with tools to create, score and fill it and to write CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules and GEMINI.md from it.
rules: Call faf_auto to create or fill project.faf from the repo, then faf_score to see which slots are empty; faf_go suggests the goal and six W's for the user to confirm.
Treat project.faf as the source of the project's facts; faf_claude writes CLAUDE.md from it, and with all: true also AGENTS.md, .cursorrules and GEMINI.md.
A core set of tools is listed by default; set FAF_TOOLS=all to list the rest. Every tool is callable by name either way.
